assets.retrieval_method: Figma MCP get_figjam(includeImagesOfNodes) inline image, saved as PNG
Figma MCP get_figjam(includeImagesOfNodes) inline image, saved as PNG

assets.derivation: byte copy of reference-source.png; measured scale is 1, so no resampling is applied
4x nearest-neighbor enlargement of a 160x24 native title-strip crop used to judge crispness; not an authoritative source

limitation: The byte-exact original upload could not be exported. The only endpoint that returns the original S3 object, GET /v1/files/:key/images, needs the files:read OAuth scope; the local Figma credential is scoped mcp:connect only and returns 403 on every REST v1 call including /v1/me. download_assets (which returns rawImages) refuses FigJam files. The originals were read in-process through the Figma Plugin API (getImageByHash().getBytesAsync()) and hashed there, but use_figma truncates its response at 20KB so 2.06MB of bytes cannot be ferried out. The stored copies are the highest-fidelity obtainable form: correct native dimensions, 91.4% of pixels byte-identical to the original, max channel error 6/255.
